fields.article_title: Airport Experience at Accra International Airport on Educational Trip  by Benedicta Owusu
fields.introduction: An educational trip plays an important role in the life of every student because it connects the theory class with the practicals. I had the opportunity to visit Accra International Airport for the very second time, but this time I went as a student to explore a few activities at the airport organized by the International Travel and Tourism Institute (ITTI). The main purpose of the trip was to study operations within the airport. During the trip, we visited different sections of the airport and literally observed how the airport operates on a daily basis.
